name: UCLA Health
notes: Researched from public uclahealth.org Bill Pay & Financial Help and Billing FAQ pages (no sign-in). Hospital and physician services bill separately (California practice). Online: sign in to myUCLAhealth (Epic MyChart) to view and pay; login help 855-364-7052. Phone payments 24/7 with no service charge, needing the guarantor number from the statement and date of birth: physicians 310-301-8860 press 1, hospital 310-825-8021 press 1. Mail to the address on the statement (physician checks payable to UCLA Medical Group; hospital checks to The Regents of the University of California). Since Feb. 21, 2024 everyone with a myUCLAhealth account is enrolled in paperless billing automatically; opt out in Billing Summary. Payment plans are arranged with a customer service representative (no online plan described), so payment_arrangement is modelled phone-only. Billing office: physicians 310-301-8860 Mon-Fri 7-7; hospital 310-825-8021 Mon-Fri 7:30-4; messages via myUCLAhealth. Guest pay, AutoPay, online methods and online fees are not described publicly (family defaults kept). Reviewer (2026-10-10): mail PO boxes added from the FAQ. UCLA's public pages do not mention MyChart guest pay; the family's Pay as Guest page is kept (not documented). Account activation links come from the physician's office.

sources.title: Medical Bill Payment Portal & Billing Department Information

paperless.note: Everyone with a myUCLAhealth account is enrolled in paperless billing. To get paper statements again, opt out from the Billing Summary.

payment_arrangement.note: Payment plans are arranged with a customer service representative. Call 310-301-8860 for physician bills or 310-825-8021 for hospital bills.

help.title: Ways to pay your UCLA Health bill
paragraphs: Online: sign in to myUCLAhealth to view and pay your bill securely. For help signing in, call 855-364-7052.

By phone: pay any day, 24 hours a day, with no service charge. Have the guarantor number from your statement and your date of birth. For physicians' bills call 310-301-8860 and press 1; for hospital bills call 310-825-8021 and press 1.

By mail: physician bills go to UCLA Medical Group Patient Pay, PO Box 748156, Los Angeles, CA 90074-8156, with checks payable to UCLA Medical Group. Hospital bills go to UCLA Health, Patient Business Services, PO Box 748260, Los Angeles, CA 90074-8260, with checks payable to The Regents of the University of California.
Hospitals and physicians in California bill separately, so one visit can produce two statements.

help.title: Paperless billing
paragraphs: Since February 21, 2024, patients with myUCLAhealth accounts are enrolled in paperless billing, and paper statements are no longer mailed unless you opt out.
To go back to paper statements, sign in to myUCLAhealth and open the Billing Summary section. Questions about paperless billing: 310-301-8860, Monday to Friday 7 a.m. to 7 p.m.

help.title: If you cannot pay in full
paragraphs: To keep your account from becoming delinquent, speak with a customer service representative to set up a reasonable payment plan. You can also apply for the UCLA Health financial assistance program.

help.title: Billing contacts
paragraphs: Physician services: 310-301-8860, Monday to Friday 7 a.m. to 7 p.m. Hospital services: 310-825-8021, Monday to Friday 7:30 a.m. to 4 p.m. You can also message the billing team through myUCLAhealth.
For copies of statements, sign in to myUCLAhealth or call the physician or hospital number above.
